anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Like with like, groups fed together.

pass_a_gloss: For gathering the crowds not similarly of those chewing his bread but the like with the like he sets before them. And the next saying brought on is like and the same in force to the things being interpreted.
pass_b_english: For gathering the crowds not in the same way as those who chew his bread, but the like with the like, he sets it before them. And the next saying that follows is like, and the same in force as what is being interpreted.
source_text: [Τ]οὺς γὰρ λαοὺς οὐχ ὁμοίως τῶν ἄρτον τρωγόντων αὐτοῦ <ἀλλὰ> τοὺς ὁμοίους μετὰ τῶν ὁμοίων συναγαγὼν παρατίθησιν αὐτοῖς. Καὶ τὸ ἑξῆς δὲ ἐπιφερόμενον ῥητὸν ὅμοιον καὶ ταὐτόν ἐστιν τῇ δυνάμει τοῖς ἑρμηνευομένοις. ||
